protocol.status: Locally specified after the exploratory pilot, before this confirmation run; not public preregistration
protocol.question: Do same-transaction wallet co-participation features improve prefix-only collapse prediction across subsequent calendar periods, and do validation alert budgets transfer?
protocol.population: MELT eventual migrants only; no all-launch or confirmed-fraud claim
protocol.target: Released min_ratio < 0.3 within 20 minutes after migration
protocol.maturity: Migration + 1 hour; training labels ready before validation start and validation labels ready before test start
protocol.features: Identical prefix activity/holdings inputs, with versus without the six pilot co-participation summaries
protocol.threshold: Separate validation thresholds for each fitted model at an empirical 5% false-positive budget; no test adjustment
protocol.primary_comparison: Random-forest co-participation minus base AP, averaging predictions over three seeds, then test-count-weighted within-period AP deltas
protocol.uncertainty: 500 paired calendar-day bootstrap repetitions within each test period; conditional on fixed fitted models
protocol.diagnostic: Share of prefix wallets absent from labeled training prefixes; subgroup boundary is median validation novelty share, without using test outcomes. This is wallet overlap, not operator identity
protocol.interpretation: A positive interval is evidence within this dataset, not automatically a novel contribution. Failed confirmation will be retained. Secondary comparisons remain exploratory

limits: Same historical MELT source period; token-disjoint confirmation is not an external dataset.
Only eventual migrants; price collapse is not confirmed fraud.
Wallet overlap diagnostic does not identify creators or operators.
Different horizon cohorts; scores cannot quantify benefit of waiting.
Bootstrap is conditional on fitted models; secondary comparisons are exploratory.
Protocol specified after pilot exploration, not a public preregistration.
These fixed models do not exhaust tuned 119-feature coordination or graph baselines.
